asset.name: Welcome: your Microsoft 365 account
asset.description: Sent to the new starter's personal email with their sign-in name once the account exists.
asset.subject: Welcome to Contoso, {{form.given_name}}: your sign-in name
asset.html_body:
Welcome, {{form.given_name}}

Your work account is ready for your first day on {{=FORMAT_DATE(form.start_date, "D MMMM YYYY")}}.

Sign-in name: {{user_principal_name}}

Your manager will give you a one-time pass for your first sign-in, when you will set up Microsoft Authenticator and your password.

Start at My Account on your first day.

Sent by the account provisioning workflow
